message.name: GR_CMD_SIG
message.description: Ed25519 signature by the ground agent over one uplink command frame and a monotonic counter.
message.field: Message id of the signed command.
Sender system id of the signed command.
Sender component id of the signed command.
Sequence number of the signed command frame.
Ed25519 signature over counter and the command frame.

message.name: GR_COMMIT
message.description: Signed commitment of the security-relevant downlink frames the onboard agent forwarded in one window (one chunk). Entries are 6 bytes: seq, msgid, first 4 bytes of SHA-256(frame).
message.field: Number of chunks in the window.
Number of entries in this chunk.
Ed25519 signature over window_id, chunk, n_chunks, count and entries.
Up to 30 entries; declared last so MAVLink2 trims unused bytes.
